selected_script.angle: Kitchen Counter Roll Clutter to Brushed Gold Under-Cabinet Organizer Upgrade
selected_script.hook: Stop letting messy, unravelling paper towel and plastic wrap rolls crowd your kitchen countertops.

usage_steps_used: Mount base plate onto cabinet underside using adhesive backing, pressing firmly 1 time
Slide a paper towel roll onto the open end of the long holding bar past the circular end cap in 1 sliding push motion

script_record.0-3s: Show a messy, unravelling paper towel roll cluttering a busy kitchen countertop, getting knocked over.
script_record.3-6s: Show the rectangular base plate of the brushed gold SUS304 stainless steel paper towel holder mounted horizontally under the cabinet using the adhesive backing, pressing firmly.
script_record.6-10s: A hand slides a standard paper towel roll past the flat circular end cap onto the 11.81in holding rod with a smooth sliding push motion.
script_record.10-14s: A close-up shot of a hand tearing a clean sheet off the paper towel roll mounted under the cabinet smoothly.
script_record.14-18s: Show a plastic wrap roll stored vertically on the wall-mounted gold holder in a clean organized kitchen.
script_record.18-20s: Light CTA text overlay: Make your space cleaner and cozier.
